risk_if_not_implemented: Without Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training, users, services and processes may obtain or retain access beyond authorized need, enabling misuse or escalation. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Lack of a security-minded workforce (R-SA-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to provide all employees and contractors appropriate security, compliance and resilience awareness education and training that is relevant for their job function.
compensating_control_1.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training (SAT-04) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training (SAT-05) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Security, Compliance & Resilience Training Records
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to document, retain and monitor individual training activities, including:
(1) Initial security, compliance and resilience awareness training;
(2) Recurring awareness training; and
(3) Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS)-specific training.
compensating_control_2.justification: Security, Compliance & Resilience Training Records (SAT-10) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training (SAT-05) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
